QUOTE: `StdioTransport::stderr_reader_loop` | `StdioTransport::open` | Drains child-process stderr; `SSETransport::sse_reader_loop` | `SSETransport::open` | Reads the SSE event stream
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names a stderr reader thread spawned in StdioTransport::open and an SSE event reader thread spawned in SSETransport::open.
